component.name: Ledger
component.summary: COSMIC panel applet tracking AI usage and credits

description.p: Ledger is a native COSMIC panel applet that tracks your AI coding quota and prepaid credits across Claude Code, Codex, OpenRouter, OpenCode Go, and more directly from your panel. Add accounts once and Ledger fetches usage directly from provider APIs. No telemetry, no cloud sync, and no third-party accounts required.

ul.li: Claude Code usage tracking and extra usage meter
Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, Grok, and OpenCode Go support
Clean, flat monochrome design inspired by Omarchy

description.p: Adds the OpenRouter provider and token usage charts, and redesigns the applet.

ul.li: New OpenRouter provider: daily and weekly spend, credit balance, and tokens by day and model
Tokens by day and by model for Claude and OpenRouter
Flat, minimalist redesign of the popup and settings
Grok's weekly limit is no longer shown twice

description.p: Initial release of Ledger for the COSMIC desktop.
